lines.text: The LORD tells those who seek Him to look to the rock they were cut from and to Abraham.
The LORD will comfort Zion and make her wilderness like Sinai and her desert like the garden of the LORD.
The heavens will vanish like smoke and the earth will wear out like a garment, but His salvation lasts forever.
The LORD dried up the sea and made a road for the redeemed, who enter Zion crowned with everlasting joy.
The LORD asks why they fear a man who withers like cedar, and says the captive will be freed.
